mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_monthly_usage (tenant_id, billing_month, reserved_cost_usd) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{billingMonth}, #{amount}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, billing_month) DO UPDATE SET reserved_cost_usd = CASE WHEN batch.console_ai_monthly_usage.reserved_updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN EXCLUDED.reserved_cost_usd ELSE batch.console_ai_monthly_usage.reserved_cost_usd + EXCLUDED.reserved_cost_usd END, reserved_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_monthly_usage (tenant_id, billing_month, reserved_cost_usd) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{billingMonth}, #{amount} WHERE #{amount} <= #{budget} ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, billing_month) DO UPDATE SET reserved_cost_usd = CASE WHEN batch.console_ai_monthly_usage.reserved_updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN EXCLUDED.reserved_cost_usd ELSE batch.console_ai_monthly_usage.reserved_cost_usd + EXCLUDED.reserved_cost_usd END, reserved_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE batch.console_ai_monthly_usage.estimated_cost_usd + CASE WHEN batch.console_ai_monthly_usage.reserved_updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN 0 ELSE batch.console_ai_monthly_usage.reserved_cost_usd END + EXCLUDED.reserved_cost_usd <= #{budget} RETURNING TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE batch.console_ai_monthly_usage SET reserved_cost_usd = GREATEST(0, reserved_cost_usd - #{reservedAmount}), estimated_cost_usd = estimated_cost_usd + #{actualAmount}, request_count = request_count + 1, prompt_tokens = prompt_tokens + #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = completion_tokens + #{completionTokens}, reserved_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND billing_month = #{billingMonth}

UPDATE batch.console_ai_monthly_usage SET reserved_cost_usd = GREATEST(0, reserved_cost_usd - #{reservedAmount}), reserved_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND billing_month = #{billingMonth}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, billing_month, request_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, reserved_cost_usd FROM batch.console_ai_monthly_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND billing_month = #{billingMonth}
